learning.filter: Competition window, bot desks only (the human is excluded), closed trades scored WIN / LOSS / BREAKEVEN. Win rate = W ÷ (W+L) with breakevens shown apart. takeaways: By stop distance the <2% band earns 0.2R per trade on average (n=65); the 2–4% band loses 0.09R (n=91).
Targets planned at 2–2.5× risk hit 35% of the time and targets at 2.5–3.5× hit 37% — no penalty for the wider target in this window.
Picks that cited news or social intel won 50% (n=18) against 34% for picks that did not (n=159).
